description: System-wide ad-blocker and privacy guard for Windows, macOS and Linux
notes: This is the vendor's 'noselfupdate' build: self-updates are compiled out (the linked binary sets selfupdate.NoSelfUpdate=true, so no updater is ever created, no update manifest is fetched and no app-update.yml/squirrel component exists). Update Zen with 'scoop update zen-desktop'.

Zen does not register itself for autostart on first run. The 'Autostart' switch in Settings calls autostart.Manager.Enable(), which only then writes HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run value 'Zen' = '<path to Zen.exe> --start --hidden'. Nothing is pre-written by this manifest, so the checkbox starts out off.

All state (Config\config.json, certificates, cached filter lists, Logs) lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Zen, outside the Scoop directory, so it survives updates; nothing is written next to Zen.exe and there is nothing to persist.
Zen sets the system proxy while running and installs a local root CA the first time you start the proxy; both are user-controlled from the app.
The interface is rendered by Wails and needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (preinstalled on Windows 11 and up-to-date Windows 10).
